static_traits.name: Zhou Dean
static_traits.family_status: 父母为Lawyer；有少量可沟通的朋友和家人，但尚not yet与其讨论此具体问题
static_traits.social_status: 因回避涉及泳装的社交活动，友谊与家庭互动受影响，Restricted social participation
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；青少年时期形成疤痕；曾有与体像相关的类似回避行为；without既往心理治疗或心理Intervention史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯、配合度高；语气偏消极，反复强调“很难”“without法”，自动化思维强烈；愿意尝试记录想法与逐步练习

basic_info.main_problem: 我回避穿泳装，因为我相信人们会认为我太胖或会根据我的疤痕来评判我，这让我感到强烈的自我意识与not适。
basic_info.core_demands: “我想在自己的皮肤里感到舒适，not再让这些想法控制我的生活。我希望能去海滩或泳池，而not再对自己感到那么糟糕。”
growth_experiences: In adolescence scars appeared, and peers commented on her body shape; the stress level was moderate at the time; since then she gradually formed high sensitivity to and shame about others' gazes and evaluations, and began avoiding any occasion requiring a swimsuit. Over time (especially in summer or when going to places with water activities), this avoidance became more marked, lasting for years and affecting social life and confidence.
长期独自应对体像困扰与回避行为，not yet曾寻求心理治疗或与支持系统深入讨论具体问题，逐渐固化为稳定的“回避—暂时缓解—生活受限”的循环。

core_beliefs: 我有缺陷（太胖、带疤痕），因此not被他人接受
Others will negatively judge me because of my appearance

special_situations.event: Summer or occasions requiring swimwear such as going to the beach / pool
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人看见我的疤痕或身材，他们就会认为我太胖并评判我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 完全回避涉及穿泳装的活动，not穿泳装、以遮盖身体来避免被看见
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will stare at me, see that I am fat, and see my scars

special_situations.event: Friends or family issue invitations to pool / beach activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I attend, they will notice my appearance and form negative views of me; refusing to attend avoids being judged
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes excuses to decline or cancel related activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会在心里看not起我，觉得我难看

special_situations.event: When trying on or considering buying swimwear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果泳装not能遮盖缺陷，就说明我很糟糕、have not任何办法能改善
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 寻找过度遮盖的衣物或干脆not购买、not试穿
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我看起来很糟，穿什么都have not用

special_situations.event: Recalls peers' negative comments about body shape during adolescence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I was mocked back then, I will inevitably be mocked now too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to stay away from any social scene that might expose his body
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: History will repeat itself; they will still laugh at me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized; to be able to comfortably show her body and participate in social activities
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, humiliated, and excluded, worries about experiencing the pain of being laughed at again
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and self-esteem by avoiding situations that expose her body
Mainly covers up, reducing being seen, to avoid potential negative evaluation

object_relations.self_representation: A shameful, flawed person under scrutiny

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests cognitive restructuring or behavioral experiments to test assumptions about others' evaluations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于认为改变很难、这些念头“太真实”，若参与实验会感到暴露与not安全
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以同理和验证为基调，先承认困难与担忧；use温和、具体化的Questioning，帮助将任务拆分为微步骤，并邀请其以低风险场景开展微型实验。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about sharing body-image troubles and specific avoidance problems with friends or family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于认为说出来会被评判或给他人添麻烦，因此选择not表达
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain a safe treatment atmosphere, encourage naming emotions with feeling vocabulary; allow pauses and silence, with supportive language gradually invite them to try limited sharing within a small scope.

manifestations: Avoids swimsuit-related social activities, leading to reduced interaction with friends and family
not yet与自身支持系统讨论此具体问题，倾向独自承受
outcomes: Restricted range of experiences, decreased participation

manifestations: 长期回避使Restricted life choices，难以Freedom参与海滩/泳池活动

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 反复认为do not人会盯着自己的疤痕、认为自己太胖并进行负面评价
In public, feeling watched and judged by 'everyone'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 选择回避泳装活动、Repression参与冲动并对自身施加限制
not yet向朋友和家人分享困扰，转而独自承受not适与羞耻感

positive_force: Has some social support (has friends and family to communicate with)
Increased self-awareness: clearly recognizes that avoidance limits life and proactively seeks help
Strong motivation: willing to try recording automatic thoughts and practicing gradually
negative_force: 长期回避策略巩固羞耻与Anxiety
Over-focuses on others' evaluations (mind reading, jumping to conclusions)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids wearing swimsuits and related water activities
antecedent: Summer or occasions requiring swimwear such as the beach/pool
Thinking that others may stare at or comment on one's body and scars
Recalls experiences in adolescence of peers commenting on his body shape
target_behavior.core_reason: 青少年时期形成疤痕并遭遇同伴身材评论，引发体像羞耻与Anxiety；对他人评价的灾难化预测与读心术思维加固回避
target_behavior.function: Escaping judgment and shame, reducing anxiety in the short term与not适
target_behavior.consequence: 社交生活与关系受限，without法享受海滩/泳池等活动，Decreased confidence与Emotional distress worsening
